classes.invariant: The plan requires public-handler acceptance for the correction gate.

An in-card correction-gate plan names the exact production handler and implementation scope, defines executable positive and negative acceptance evidence, and states fail-closed behavior when that evidence fails.
classes.procedure: Inspect the plan against the repository's documented production handler and verify that it identifies the handler and affected behavior, specifies executable assertions for success and rejection paths, and makes failed acceptance block completion.

debt.summary: the correction gate lacked public-handler acceptance

debt.remedy: Revise the plan to name critique_branch and the exact correction-gate behavior being changed; require an executable handler-level positive test plus a negative test proving failed gate acceptance blocks settlement and persistence; enumerate the assertions and state that any failed assertion prevents completion.
debt.summary: The public-handler obligation closes the narrow historical gate, but the implementation card remains under-specified because it names neither the handler nor executable success, rejection, and fail-closed acceptance boundaries.

review_state.stakes: One trusted operator and OS; repository and plan bytes are untrusted data; no hostile local race or repository execution; one class and one claim-free plan; false clearance is high impact and recoverable blocking is acceptable.
